<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def redhash(f):
    g=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.split('\n')]
    red=frozenset((r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if g[r][c]=='R')
    return hash(red), len(red)
def ppos(f):
    g=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.split('\n')]
    bl=[(r,c) for r in range(6,47) for c in range(64) if g[r][c]=='b']
    rs=[r for r,c in bl]; cs=[c for r,c in bl]
    return (min(rs),min(cs))
def bar(f): return f.ascii.split('\n')[63].count('b')
print("start red", redhash(current_frame), "player", ppos(current_frame), "bar", bar(current_frame))
for i in range(4):
    action(['DOWN'])
    print(f"after DOWN {i+1}: red", redhash(current_frame), "player", ppos(current_frame), "bar", bar(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def redhash(f):
    g=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.split('\n')]
    red=frozenset((r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if g[r][c]=='R')
    return hash(red), len(red)
def ppos(f):
    g=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.split('\n')]
    bl=[(r,c) for r in range(6,47) for c in range(64) if g[r][c]=='b']
    rs=[r for r,c in bl]; cs=[c for r,c in bl]
    return (min(rs),min(cs))
def bar(f): return f.ascii.split('\n')[63].count('b')
